job.goal: A brand explainer that introduces the product and what it does

scenes.brief: Show the Orinovate logo and tagline on a clean background.
A sweeping aerial shot over a modern factory floor, highlighting Orinovate's smart manufacturing platform in action.
A composed hero image of the Orinovate dashboard interface displaying real-time analytics and AI insights.
Demonstrate the user navigating the Orinovate app to set up a new production line, from selecting a template to confirming the launch.
Display the call-to-action: 'Start building smarter with Orinovate today' with website URL.

beats.text: Orinovate introduces its smart manufacturing platform.
A sweeping aerial view glides over a bustling factory floor, showcasing Orinovate's smart manufacturing platform operating in real time.
The Orinovate dashboard displays live analytics, AI-driven insights, and key performance metrics in a clean, intuitive layout.
The user selects a template, configures machine parameters, and launches the new production line with a single click.
